bear: add dev utility for compilation commands This package generates compile_commands.json by wrapping the build command and inspecting all the commands that were called via fork and exec. The compile_commands.json can then be used to help with syntax checking during development. Example usage: bear -o ../compile_commands.json ./build_packages --withdev \ --board=${BOARD} && bear -a -o ../compile_commands.json \ ./build_image --board=${BOARD} --noenable_rootfs_verification test TEST=emerge and run build while wrapping with bear BUG=None Change-Id: I5cd13c2a55ca8bef333ab4c471f364c7eea54660 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/804710 Commit-Ready: Kenny Root <kroot@google.com> Tested-by: Kenny Root <kroot@google.com> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>

login: Sanitize sentinel flags in Chrome startup flags Make sure that policy sentinel flags (--policy-switches-begin, --policy-switches-end) can't be injected in the middle of the Chrome startup flags. Without this, Chrome's command line parsing logic may be fooled into not seeing the additional flags when deciding whether the restart is required. BUG=chromium:707539 TEST=new unit test, manual test: set DeviceStartUpFlags policy to "--policy-switches-end --any-chrome-flag" and check that browser is restarted during user sign-in Change-Id: I0344613a9308323746007e9137f5e3e323923d4f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/843183 Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

iw: upgraded package to upstream Upgraded net-wireless/iw to version 4.9. cros_portage_upgrade was only picking up 4.3, because newer versions were marked EAPI 6. So I manually uprev'd the 4.3 ebuild to 4.9. Among the possible reasons for upgrading: this includes parsing code for some new WoWLAN triggers ("wake up on network detection"). BUG=none TEST=wifi_matfunc suite Change-Id: I9d55787d708c206a234a8c7165ef2cf4d239a650 Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/841628

CHROMIUM: disablevmx: delay call to control_vmx In the post kaiser world the kernel can't handle a potential fault from wrmsrl_safe so early. In order to avoid this, do cpu_control_vmx later in the cpu boot up process. BUG=789027 TEST=boot eve and samus in dev mode with "disablevmx=off", start a VM. boot eve without "disablevmx=off" check that vmx is restricted and not in /proc/cpuinfo. Change-Id: I6850f41a0c74e068a9dbb2b48fbdaf29f7273a3d Signed-off-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/843202 Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>
